RitualPatternDef.label: festival of Verdantia
RitualPatternDef.description: A fivefold spring celebration in honor of Terra's bounty. The faithful feast, plant, sing, and renew their oath to the living land.

RitualPatternDef.label: night of reflection
RitualPatternDef.description: A moonlit vigil of silence, confession, and contemplation sacred to Lunaria and Umbra.

RitualPatternDef.label: rite of passing
RitualPatternDef.description: A solemn funeral in which the dead are named, remembered, and entrusted to the boundary beyond breath.

RitualPatternDef.label: trial of flame and shadow
RitualPatternDef.description: An ordeal of endurance and symbolic combat. The initiate must prove they can bear both radiance and darkness without being consumed by either.

RitualOutcomeEffectDef.label: blessing of renewal
RitualOutcomeEffectDef.description: The colony feels renewed by Terra's bounty.

RitualOutcomeEffectDef.label: silver clarity
RitualOutcomeEffectDef.description: The faithful carry quiet insight from their vigil.

RitualOutcomeEffectDef.label: ancestral peace
RitualOutcomeEffectDef.description: The dead are remembered, and the living feel steadied by continuity.

RitualOutcomeEffectDef.label: tempered spirit
RitualOutcomeEffectDef.description: The initiate emerges hardened by ordeal and humbled by balance.
